name: What this mission does
description: One sentence you'll still understand in three months.
_schedule_help: Minute Hour DayOfMonth Month DayOfWeek. '0 2 * * *' = 2am daily. '30 8 * * 1-5' = 8:30am weekdays. '0 */4 * * *' = every 4 hours. Leave blank to run it manually only.
authorizations: _help: Sentences here let this mission do high-risk things unattended. Only add what you actually mean, and only while you want it. Examples: 'You have permission to post to TikTok, today only.' or 'You have permission to spend up to $10 on video generation.' Delete this line and the examples below if the mission doesn't need any.

params.prompt:
Using this: {research}

Write the thing I actually want.

steps.name: Step three - do something with it

_plugins_help: Run `jarvis plugins` to list every plugin and tool you can use here. Built-ins include: web_search, read_webpage, llm, ai, text_to_speech, generate_image, generate_video, generate_avatar_video, merge_video_audio, post_to_social, notify, write_file, read_file, list_files, move_file, run_command, wait.
_placeholders_help: Use {output_key} to reuse an earlier step's result. {scripts[*].title} pulls one field from every item in a list. {results[0].url} takes the first one.
_on_error_help: Each step takes on_error: 'stop' (default), 'continue' (skip it and carry on), or 'retry' (with retries: 3).
_condition_help: Add condition: 'some_output_key' to skip a step when an earlier step produced nothing.
